verdict.rationale: Close ships Chloe, a built-in AI sales agent that calls leads, qualifies prospects, books meetings, and updates the CRM automatically. It is included on every plan and can be used inside automated workflows, so users can delegate real tasks to it within the product. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the scope of delegable tasks beyond sales calling and qualification, and independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works as claimed.
